newsitem.title: GERMANY: German builders push up Jan jobless figures.
newsitem.headline: German builders push up Jan jobless figures.

text.p: German Federal Labour Office chief Bernhard Jagoda said on Thursday that winter unemployment in the country's construction-related industries accounted for nearly half of the jump in January joblessness.
Earlier, the labour office said German unemployment surged by 510,000 to a new post-war unadjusted record of 4.66 million in January.
"In both (the east and west of the country), two-fifths of the increase came from people in the construction industry (and related branches)," Jagoda told a news briefing.
The January rise in unemployment in the construction sector means that now something approaching a third of all German builders are without a job.
Jagoda said however that he saw a clear reduction in the overall German jobless rate in spring.
